method: Part headings are the 13.5pt lines 'Part X <title>' in the PDF (PyMuPDF spans). A Part owns the pages strictly between its heading page and the next Part's heading page. A heading page itself holds two Parts (the heading sits mid-page) so it is NOT resolved; nor are the cover/amendment pages before Part A's heading. Page numbers are 1-based PDF pages (= regulatory_provisions.pdf_page).
